q: Do I need to be fast?
a: No. We run in pace groups and nobody is left behind. Walkers are welcome too.

q: When and where do you meet?
a: Mostly Saturdays at the Jinja Bridge viewpoint. Some weeks we also run on Monday, Wednesday or Thursday. See the Events page for dates.

q: I am slow or just starting. Is there a group for me?
a: Yes. Seed walkers cover 1 to 4 km at a gentle walk or easy jog, and we also run aerobics sessions. Nobody is left behind.
Joining a run is free. Membership is optional and covers club kit and race transport.

q: I am visiting Jinja. Can I join?
a: Yes, please do. Come to any run and introduce yourself to the captain.
